column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Flies of death” is rendered “Dead flies”; NASB omits “ferments” and adds “so.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “directs him.”
“His heart is lacking” is rendered “his sense is lacking,” and “he says to everyone [that] he [is] a fool” as “he demonstrates to everyone that he is a fool.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Spirit” is rendered “temper,” “place” as “position,” and “calmness causes great sins to rest” as “composure allays great offenses.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Inadvertence” is rendered “error.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “riding” and “walking.”
Close to the Hebrew; The future “he will fall” is rendered “may fall.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“The faces” is rendered “its edge,” and the last clause as “Wisdom has the advantage of giving success.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “Without charming” is rendered “before being charmed,” and “the master of the tongue” as “the charmer.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Favor” is rendered “gracious,” and “swallows” as “consume.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Evil madness” is rendered “wicked madness.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “so” and “even.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A youth” is rendered “a lad,” and “eat” as “feast.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A son of nobles” is rendered “of nobility,” and “drinking” as “drunkenness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Laziness” is rendered “indolence,” and “lowering of hands” as “slackness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Laughter” is rendered “enjoyment,” and “money answers everything” as “money is the answer to everything.”
“In your mind (thought)” is rendered “in your bedchamber,” and “an owner of wings” as “the winged creature.”
